Two ways to guard a crossing
Hardware decides which way data can go. Rules and inspection decide what may go.

Three layers. Bottom: hardware decides the direction. Middle: rules decide what may pass. Top: inspection looks inside the file. Say it aloud: no matching rule, no transfer. If asked about firewalls: a firewall is software, and software has had vulnerabilities. The gateway isolates with hardware, on simple laws of physics.
Mechanism of the Gateway and the FlowRule engine list, from product documentation.
Three isometric slabs stacking up, bottom slab labelled physics. A packet falls on the top slab, passes through, and stops at the bottom one in the wrong direction. Gold on the direction cue only.
Isn't this a firewall with extra steps? -> A firewall filters traffic that can travel both ways. Here the return path does not exist in hardware; inspection sits on top.
